subject: maths

chapters.name: Sets and Relations
chapters.notes: Equivalence relations are covered in Class 12 Part 1, Ch 1. Advanced also lists symmetric difference and De Morgan's laws.

chapters.name: Logarithms
chapters.notes: Main names logarithmic functions but not the laws of logs; log-equation questions are rare in Main (about 0.07 per shift). Treated as Main + Advanced; the basics are needed everywhere.

chapters.name: Quadratic Equations
chapters.notes: Advanced adds the statement of the fundamental theorem of algebra and symmetric functions of roots.

chapters.name: Complex Numbers
chapters.notes: The square root of a complex number and the triangle inequality were dropped from Main in 2024. Advanced still lists the triangle inequality, cube roots of unity, polar form and geometric interpretation.

chapters.name: Sequences and Series
chapters.notes: Main covers only AP, GP, inserting means and the AM-GM relation. Advanced adds infinite GP and the sums of n, n^2 and n^3. Harmonic progression is in neither current syllabus.

chapters.name: Binomial Theorem
chapters.notes: Properties of binomial coefficients were dropped from Main in 2024 but are still in Advanced. Both syllabi cover only a positive integral index.

chapters.name: Matrices
chapters.notes: Advanced lists elementary row and column transformations. Main does not.

chapters.name: Determinants
chapters.notes: Main 2026 lists evaluation, area of a triangle, adjoint and inverse, and consistency of linear equations using matrices. Coaching summaries report that properties of determinants were cut from Main in 2024.

chapters.name: Trigonometric Ratios and Identities
chapters.notes: Heights and distances were dropped from Main in 2024. Advanced adds periodicity and graphs, and multiple and sub-multiple angle formulae.

chapters.name: Trigonometric Equations
chapters.notes: Not named in the NTA 2026 syllabus, but still asked in JEE Main: about 0.3–0.4 questions per shift in 2024–2026 (6–8 a year). Treated as Main + Advanced.

chapters.name: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
chapters.notes: Advanced covers principal values only, plus elementary properties.

chapters.name: Functions
chapters.ncert_chapter: Class 12 Part 1, Ch 1 (introduced in Class 11, Ch 2)
chapters.notes: Advanced explicitly lists even and odd functions, invertible functions, and special functions such as greatest integer and absolute value.

chapters.name: Limits
chapters.notes: Advanced names L'Hospital's rule explicitly.

chapters.name: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.notes: Advanced adds continuity of composite functions and the intermediate value property.

chapters.name: Methods of Differentiation
chapters.ncert_chapter: Class 12 Part 1, Ch 5 (basics in Class 11, Ch 12)
chapters.notes: Both syllabi go up to second-order derivatives and cover implicit functions.

chapters.name: Application of Derivatives
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names only rate of change, monotonicity, and maxima and minima. Tangents and normals, Rolle's theorem and LMVT are in Advanced only. Rolle's and LMVT were dropped from Main in 2024.

chapters.name: Definite Integration
chapters.notes: The definite integral as the limit of a sum is listed in Advanced but was dropped from Main in 2024.

chapters.name: Differential Equations
chapters.notes: Both syllabi cover separation of variables, homogeneous equations and linear first-order equations. Advanced also lists forming a differential equation.

chapters.name: Straight Lines
chapters.notes: Advanced adds shift of origin, angle bisectors, family of lines through an intersection point, and the incentre. Translation of axes was dropped from Main in 2024.

chapters.name: Circles
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names standard and general forms, the diameter form, and intersection of a line with a circle centred at the origin. Tangents, normals, chords, parametric form and families of circles are named only in Advanced.

chapters.name: Parabola
chapters.notes: Main names standard-form equations only. Advanced adds focus, directrix, eccentricity, parametric form, and tangents and normals.

chapters.name: Ellipse
chapters.notes: Same Main/Advanced split as Parabola.

chapters.name: Hyperbola
chapters.notes: Same Main/Advanced split as Parabola.

chapters.name: Vector Algebra
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names only scalar (dot) and vector (cross) products. Scalar and vector triple products are named only in Advanced.

chapters.name: Three Dimensional Geometry
chapters.ncert_chapter: Class 12 Part 2, Ch 11 (introduced in Class 11, Ch 11)
chapters.notes: Main 2026 covers only points, direction cosines and ratios, and lines, including skew lines and the shortest distance between them. Planes appear only in Advanced.

chapters.name: Statistics
chapters.notes: Added to Advanced in its 2023 revision, according to secondary sources.

chapters.name: Conditional Probability, Bayes' Theorem and Random Variables
chapters.notes: Bernoulli trials and the binomial distribution were dropped from Main in 2024 and are not named in Advanced 2026. Advanced covers the mean and variance of a random variable.

uncertainties: The 2027 syllabi are not published yet. As of 25 Sep 2026, jeemain.nta.nic.in still links the 2026 syllabus and jeeadv.ac.in is still the 2026 site. Re-check when the JEE Main 2027 bulletin and the JEE Advanced 2027 brochure are released.

vmc_name and vmc_order are null for every chapter. No current public VMC Maths chapter list or order was found. The only public ordering found was a partial 2014 Quora answer, which was not used. The index page of your brother's VMC modules is the reliable source.

Neither official syllabus lists chapters, only units and topics. The chapter split here follows common coaching practice (for example, Limits vs Continuity vs Methods of Differentiation, and Circle/Parabola/Ellipse/Hyperbola as separate chapters).
in_main=false for Logarithms and Trigonometric Equations is based on the NTA 2026 text not naming them. NTA publishes no chapter-level mapping.
Item-level details on what was removed from Main in 2024 come from coaching and education sites comparing the old and new NTA texts, not from an NTA change notice.
The Advanced 2023 revision (triangles and HP removed, statistics added) is taken from secondary sources. The 2026 official text confirms the current state only.
NCERT chapter numbers follow the rationalised 14-chapter Class 11 edition and the 13-chapter Class 12 edition. Check them against the printed books your brother uses.
Trigonometric equations reportedly were removed from rationalised NCERT Class 11 (secondary source), so ncert_chapter is null for that chapter.
difficulty and ncert_critical are editorial judgments based on common teacher and aspirant descriptions, not on a single cited source.
